rules: This reservation and the exact V41 midpoint coordinate must be committed before construction or dev-v37 membership creation.
Membership construction and disjointness verification are primary-agent-only and must not render seed values into agent output.
Dev-v37 must be generated solely within [5000000000,6000000000), disjoint by namespace from every prior governed set without reading their membership.
The committed one-way consumer must atomically create the dev-v37 umbrella attempt before its first manifest read or baseline episode.
A started, aborted, failed, exposed, or completed dev-v37 attempt consumes that set permanently.
No dev-v37 access is authorized until exact constructions and reusable permanent-greedy and matched-greedy scorecards pass.
Held-out-v6 remains governed by ADR-0053 and cannot be read until dev-v37 passes every frozen gate.
